manifestPolicy: Read-only for implementers. Per-plan progress is recorded only in each plan's own progress log; no worker edits this manifest.

acceptanceCriteria: Every one of the 8 CSP task checkboxes in impl-plans/completed/control-surface-parity.md is checked, each with concrete per-box evidence recorded in the plan progress log.

SurfaceCatalog exists in RielaCore with SurfaceOperation, SurfaceAvailability and SurfaceCatalog.all, holding one row per current CLI command, GraphQL field, /api/v1 route, library entry point and packaged skill command block, with blocked and excluded rows carrying evidence and reasons; uniqueness tests green.
Five gate tests exist and pass on the final tree: CLI, skills, GraphQL, web API, library. A negative test that registers a dummy command without a catalog row makes the CLI gate fail.

The GraphQL SDL is generated from the DTOs plus the catalog, checked in, and covered by a byte-identical freshness test; a single-parser test asserts riela graphql, riela serve, the desktop provider and the web router share one parser.

rerunSession, resumeSession and stopSession GraphQL mutations exist, reuse the same runner paths as the CLI, authenticate like continueSession, and are covered by tests including CLI/GraphQL lineage parity.

Web and desktop instance list, detail and overview reads go through GraphQL; /api/v1/instances and the instance overview routes are removed; surviving /api/v1 routes are cataloged as excluded with reasons.

RielaLibrary facade exists with executeWorkflow, resumeSession, rerunSession, inspectWorkflow, sessionView and executeGraphQLDocument; the riela-workflow-reference skill is rewritten to those real names; the riela-auto-improve skill and the stale impl-plans/progress/plans/graphql-supervision-execution-parity.json record are deleted.
arch -arm64 /bin/zsh -lc 'swift build && swift test' at the worktree root reports zero failures beyond the known interleaved-submit timing flake, and SwiftLint is clean on changed sources.
cd web && bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun test src all pass.
All work is committed on feat/control-surface-parity and pushed to that branch only; main is untouched.
